# Geomacro

> Explainable geopolitical, macroeconomic and critical-mineral risk intelligence for human and machine decisions.

Geomacro turns real-world geopolitical, macroeconomic and strategic-resource developments into structured, explainable risk intelligence. The commercial product is the intelligence layer: live Risk Intelligence, separate verified Risk Indices, grounded Ask Geomacro, machine-readable Risk Objects, Risk Gate decision context and governed paid machine delivery.

## Current product status

- Risk Intelligence: LIVE
- Geopolitical Risk Index: LIVE
- Macroeconomic Risk Index: LIVE
- Critical Minerals Risk Index: LIVE
- Ask Geomacro: LIVE
- Research and methodology: LIVE
- Risk API: PRIVATE PILOT
- Risk Gate: PRIVATE PILOT
- Signed country and directional-corridor Risk Objects: PRIVATE PILOT
- Paid agent / x402 access: PRODUCTION GATED; real-money settlement remains fail-closed until explicit production activation

The separate public Risk Indices preserve the versioned `gri-v1.2.0` parent methodology and `gri-proof-v1.2.0` proof lineage. Historical combined-GRI snapshots remain versioned audit records, not a second live headline product.

## Risk Gate and customer-control boundary

Risk Gate is a controlled Private Pilot capability for country and directional-corridor risk workflows.

- Geomacro verifies the applicable Risk Object and returns bounded external risk context and a recommendation.
- Customer identity, permissions and policy are applied by the customer's system after the Geomacro response.
- Geomacro does not custody customer funds or authorize customer transactions.
- The external boundary remains `execution_authorized=false`.
- Stale, incomplete, expired or unverifiable risk context must not become an implicit approval.

## Data, API and agent access

API labels throughout GeoMacro use `geomacro.live /api/...`. Parenthetical HTTP methods below are required transport metadata, not part of the display name.

Free Explorer is the public website/dashboard experience, not a free structured API.

Commercial machine access is entitlement-controlled. The canonical x402 intelligence endpoint is:

- `geomacro.live /api/v1/intelligence/query` (HTTP POST)

Country category aliases use the same engine:

- `geomacro.live /api/v1/intelligence/geopolitics` (HTTP POST)
- `geomacro.live /api/v1/intelligence/macro-fx` (HTTP POST)
- `geomacro.live /api/v1/intelligence/critical-minerals` (HTTP POST)

Category aliases bind topics and accept country subjects. Use the canonical query for corridors and multiple categories. `GET` on the category paths provides discovery or explicit research views (`view=finds`, `latest`, `open-data`, `combined`). Research observations are not signed risk intelligence.

- Endpoint directory and valid JSON/cURL examples: https://geomacro.live/pricing#api-endpoints
- Official agent discovery: https://geomacro.live/api/v1/agent
- Live OpenAPI 3.1: https://geomacro.live/api/v1/agent?view=openapi
- Exact approved USDC prices: https://geomacro.live/api/v1/pricing
- Network discovery: https://geomacro.live/api/v1/payments/networks
- Non-payable price preview: `geomacro.live /api/v1/payments/preflight` (HTTP POST)
- Structural baseline availability only: `geomacro.live /api/v1/intelligence/availability` (HTTP GET/POST)
- Public unscored Finds: https://geomacro.live/api/v1/finds
- No-funds structured research: `geomacro.live /api/v1/intelligence/live-structured` (HTTP GET/POST)
- MCP JSON-RPC tools: `geomacro.live /api/mcp` (HTTP POST)

Legacy baseline availability requires one country, one eligible topic and explicit `delivery_tier=structural_baseline`. Explicit Store selection adds `product: {capability, variant}` to the same canonical query: four structural products, three intelligence-query variants, two signed-object variants and three Risk Gate bundle variants. All twelve request examples are included in official agent discovery and the API endpoint directory; MCP `store_product_query` maps to this same engine.

Structural digests require exactly one approved dimension. Profiles require at least two approved dimensions and `detail=full`; directional corridors require actual qualified observations from both endpoints in every requested dimension. Corridor output is endpoint-composed, not a physical route model. Store intelligence queries require verified signed state and a real healthy live-pipeline check, without fabricating current events. `newly_qualified_signed` additionally requires a current UTC `product.issued_after` cutoff no older than five minutes and an actual signature-verified publication after it; preflight does not issue or sign an object.

Structural baseline is not a current signed risk check. Price discovery, network discovery and a positive baseline preflight do not authorize payment. Only an exact eligible request can return a live 402 offer. Never authorize a second payment to recover an uncertain delivery. Examples demonstrate contracts, not production availability or permission to charge.

Existing entitlement-controlled partner integrations retain their own access rules.

Machine discovery:

- Agent discovery: https://geomacro.live/.well-known/geomacro-agent.json
- Commerce discovery: https://geomacro.live/.well-known/geomacro-commerce.json
- x402 discovery: https://geomacro.live/.well-known/x402.json
- OpenAPI: https://geomacro.live/openapi-x402.json

A commercial entitlement defines the permitted capability, subject scope, history depth and response limits. Payment rails do not widen the underlying Geomacro entitlement.

## Machine-payment boundary

- deliverability must be checked before a payment challenge is issued;
- unavailable, stale or commercially ineligible required coverage is not chargeable;
- successful payment unlocks only the bounded requested product;
- raw/private warehouse data is not a default customer entitlement;
- payment success does not authorize a downstream financial action;
- real-money activation remains disabled until the production acceptance gates and explicit owner authorization are satisfied.

## Product and claim boundaries

- Geomacro provides external risk context. It does not replace customer decision authority.
- Risk Gate remains non-authorizing with `execution_authorized=false`.
- Geomacro intelligence is not financial, legal, compliance or investment advice.
- Sanctions/restrictions context is not a replacement for sanctions screening or legal/compliance review.
- Missing evidence is not silently converted into zero risk.
- No independent external security audit, certification or production SLA should be inferred unless explicitly documented as completed or contracted.

## Privacy and security contact

Public intelligence can be viewed without creating an account. Private Pilot and commercial workflows may process information intentionally supplied for those workflows together with operational and audit metadata required by the implemented service. Users should never submit seed phrases, private keys or unnecessary confidential information through public surfaces.

Security contact: https://geomacro.live/.well-known/security.txt
Privacy and product-use boundaries: https://geomacro.live/about#privacy and https://geomacro.live/about#product-use
